impl.deviations:
The plan's line numbers were stale, so every edit was matched against merged main 2abb27e. Where the code differs from the plan:

1. money/index.tsx (DOS-034, which postdates the plan). The Bank it and Mark bounced dialogs already stayed open and printed deposit.error / bounce.error inline. I replaced those inline lines with `<Refusal>`, keeping the testIDs `receipt-deposit-refusal` / `receipt-bounce-refusal`, their `reset()` on open, and their stay-open behaviour. This puts them on the one rule and adds the no-connection sentence.

2. billing/credit-notes.tsx (DOS-021). DOS-021 had already moved the refusal above Draft and resets `create` on bill pick and on close. I replaced its inline line in the same place with `<Refusal of={[create]} scope={billId} testID="note-refusal" />` and kept both `create.reset()` calls.

3. billing/index.tsx IRN.
   - The Refusal and the invoice-irn Button are wrapped in a fragment inside the existing permission conditional.
   - `scope={invoice.id}` instead of the plan's `invoice?.id ?? null`, because `invoice` is already narrowed there.

4. testIDs. The plan named only some; every `<Refusal>` now has one, for QA:
   - dialogs: order-refusal, decision-refusal, draft-refusal, claim-refusal, billing-refusal, inbound-dialog-refusal, loadsheet-refusal, ewb-refusal, pack-refusal, shop-refusal, deposit-refusal, bounce-refusal, settle-refusal, reverse-refusal, adjust-refusal, transfer-refusal, gate-refusal, broadcast-refusal, revoke-refusal, brand-capture-refusal;
   - tally dialogs: tally-export-refusal and tally-mapping-refusal;

   - ExportButton: `<testID>-refusal`;
   - inbound/index uses `inbound-dialog-refusal` because the plan gives `inbound-refusal` to the messages register.

5. settings.tsx (revoke) and billing/brand-dms.tsx (capture) had a bare `<Txt>` as the dialog body. It is now wrapped in `<Stack gap={3}>` so the line can sit under it.

6. `RefusalProps` is an exported interface whose optional props include `| undefined`, matching the kit's prop style. `stayOpen` has a comment-only body, as the plan says.

7. E2E script.

8. Commit history. `2abe7e3` was amended once, message only: a shell heredoc had dropped its subject line. It was my own unpushed commit, and HEAD and an empty index were checked before amending.

9. Nothing else was changed: no contract, permission, schema or backend code, no owner-app, and no held plan.

problems.detail: The only real reproduction of the finding was not run: the E2E script covers dialogs staying open, the sentence in view, and no #error-overlay or 'Uncaught (in promise)'. This lane may not start services; only `node --check` passed. The unit spec only proves that the display rule is new (red = `refusalStart is not a function`). The code sites were checked by reading, not at runtime. The main session must run it RED on 2abb27e, then GREEN on d600ab8, against a dos_batch1_template copy, and do the planned web 1280/375, Android and iOS walks.

nextRefusal (about line 480) puts a refusal into `seen` with `shown` undefined when it arrives while ANOTHER write on the same surface is still pending, and it never shows it after that write settles. I proved this with a temporary assertion (deleted afterwards). Frames: [pending, pending], then [error A, pending] shows nothing, then [error A, success] still shows nothing. The realistic case is the documents panel (for example rematch refused while acceptMatch is still pending): that refusal stays silent. The finding's three single-write steps are not affected.

The plan asked for ExportButton to be wrapped in `<Stack gap={1}>`. Stack sets `alignSelf: 'stretch'` (web layout.tsx:163, native layout.tsx:159), and the header actions row is flex-wrap with `alignItems: 'center'` (web layout.tsx:610-617). So Export CSV may sit top-aligned next to taller header controls. When an export is refused, the Stack widens to the sentence and the button stretches with it. This is cosmetic, and the plan's 1280/375 px check of the registers, orders, money and billing headers has not been done.

The DOS-021 and DOS-034 refusal lines (note-refusal, receipt-deposit-refusal, receipt-bounce-refusal) changed from Txt label/meta to body/body when they moved onto <Refusal>. Their testIDs, placement and stay-open behaviour are kept, and dos-034-day-end.mjs does not use those testIDs, so only the look changes. Also, on iOS, most dialogs pass no `scope`: reopening one within the Modal dismiss animation may show the last sentence again (a residual the implementer already reported).

verdict.evidence:
Worktree .claude/worktrees/b1-l5-manager-errors, HEAD d600ab8 on top of 2abe7e3 and 2abb27e.

1. Scope
- `git show --stat` of both commits: 24 files in d600ab8 plus the E2E .mjs in 2abe7e3.
- Every file is in the plan's change list: api-client index.tsx, README.md (hand-written, not a generated service README) and refusal.test.ts; manager strings.ts and ui.tsx; the 19 named screens; QA/tools/e2e.
- `git diff 2abb27e HEAD --stat -- backend docs QA/findings QA/STATE.md CLAUDE.md '**/README.md'` shows only frontend/libs/api-client/README.md. No backend, contract, permission, schema, docs/22 or QA findings/state change.

2. Fail before
- Reversed the non-test changes of d600ab8 and 2abe7e3 with the prescribed `git diff C^ C -- . ':(exclude)...' | git apply -R` ("reversed d600ab8", "reversed 2abe7e3").
- `pnpm --filter @dos/api-client test -- src/react/refusal.test.ts`:
  "FAIL ... DOS-029: ... TypeError: refusalStart is not a function ❯ frames src/react/refusal.test.ts:48:15"
  "Test Files 1 failed | 7 passed (8) Tests 4 failed | 72 passed (76)"
- In the unfixed tree, `grep -rnE "done, ?done|close, ?close|\}, ?done\)" app | wc -l` = 33. For example fulfilment/index.tsx:189 `}, done)` and :191/:193 `.then(done, done)`; inbound/documents.tsx:286/290/292 `.then(done, done)`.
- documents.tsx:479 and :511: startReview and releaseReview had a `.then(ok)` with no rejection handler. No Refusal or stayOpen existed.
- Restored with `git checkout -- .`: 0 porcelain lines. No library rebuild was needed: api-client is consumed from src, and contracts/domain dist were untouched.

3. Pass after
- `pnpm --filter @dos/api-client test`: Test Files 8 passed (8), Tests 76 passed (76). typecheck exit 0; lint exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @dos/manager-app typecheck`: exit 0. lint: exit 0. test: 3 passed (3).
- `pnpm format:check` in frontend/: "All matched files use Prettier code style!"
- `node --check QA/tools/e2e/dos-029-manager-refusals.mjs`: OK.

4. Adversarial checks
- Temporary property test of nextRefusal, deleted afterwards: 3,000 random runs, 36,000 frames of 1-5 writes with random idle/pending/success/error states and scope changes.
  - Asserted `nextRefusal(next, w, sc) === next`, so the render-time setState converges in one extra render and cannot loop.
  - Asserted `shown` is always one of the current errors. Result: 2 passed.
- Temporary edge assertion, deleted: a refusal arriving while a sibling write is pending is never shown, even after the sibling settles. Result: passed (minor problem above).
- Coverage scan:
  - All 60 manager `useMutation` hooks (59 in app/, plus ExportButton's `request`) appear in some `<Refusal of=[...]>`.
  - No `done, done`, `close, close` or `}, done)` is left.
  - A bracket-aware Node scan found no `mutateAsync(...).then(` with a single argument.
  - No `onError` or `.catch` closes a surface; only sign-in and change-password use `.catch`, with their own error handling.
  - The remaining bare `.mutate()` calls (messages rows, documents accept/save/rematch, billing irn, ExportButton) are covered: `mutate` swallows the rejection (index.tsx:406-411) and each has a Refusal line.
- Client semantics:
  - `mutateAsync` stores one ApiError instance per failure and clears it on pending (index.tsx:389-398), so the identity-based `seen` is stable.
  - `toApiError` maps only aborts and TypeErrors to kind 'network'. That default ("No connection. This will send when the signal is back.") is replaced by app.writeNoConnection in <Refusal>.
- Kit: the web Dialog and Sheet return `<></>` when closed (feedback.tsx:178, :284), so the Refusal remounts and its mount rule hides stale errors. Native uses `<Modal visible>`.
- Earlier batch fixes on the same screens:
  - DOS-021 create.reset() on bill pick and close, and DOS-034 reset-on-open plus stay-open with testIDs receipt-deposit-refusal / receipt-bounce-refusal, are both kept.
  - DOS-020 and DOS-005: the decision dialog gets decision-refusal, and order confirm stays gated on `waitingOn`.
  - DOS-023, DOS-025 and DOS-041 success branches are unchanged.
  - No held plan was implemented.
- Frontend only: no backend, module-boundary, money/pieces, state-machine, idempotency or RLS surface. No screen imports react-native or react-dom (ESLint passes). A retry keeps its idempotency key because reset() is never called.

5. End state: `git status` shows "nothing to commit, working tree clean" at d600ab8.
